rationale: Fix-up resolves all three major findings from code-review-final. CR-001: module-level enrichInFlight Map shares the in-flight promise across Strict Mode remounts and always applies when the live entry still lacks the flag (no cancelled bail). CR-002: useFilePaste keeps onFilePaste in a ref updated each render so the Quill paste listener invokes the latest gate (noop when disabled). CR-003: ChatPrompt clears queued files when canAttachFiles flips false, excludes files from canSubmit, and omits file ids on submit/resume. Regression tests cover remount enrich, stale paste callback, and clear-on-disable. No new high-risk surface in the fix-up.

finding_status.evidence: useEnrichAssistantFileAttachment.ts uses module-level enrichInFlight Map; remount awaits the same promise and applyFileAttachmentEnabled always writes when entry.fileAttachmentEnabled is still undefined. Remount regression covered in useEnrichAssistantFileAttachment.test.ts.
useFilePaste.ts stores onFilePaste in onFilePasteRef updated each render; stable handlePaste calls onFilePasteRef.current. useFilePaste.test.ts asserts latest callback after rerender.

ChatPrompt.tsx clears files when !canAttachFiles; canSubmit ignores files when disabled; submit/resume send empty file lists when disabled. ChatPrompt.fileAttachment.test.tsx asserts clear-on-disable.
